meta.title: Chicot County — the money trail
meta.note: Chicot County’s County General Fund appropriation for 2025, $3,437,571, as stated in Appropriation Ordinance 2024-08 (projected County General revenues $4,264,100; the county appropriates within 90% of revenue). This is the General Fund — the county’s main operating fund; the Road fund and others are separate, so the all-funds total is larger. Adding them is on the docket.

nodes.name: County General Fund (2025)
nodes.note: The amount appropriated for the County General Fund in 2025, per the ordinance.
